scope: Nested OperationalSelection shape repair, its source-only tests, and explicit backup-attempt propagation in three existing consumers; no broad consumer re-audit
static_findings_resolved: The stopped-selection check reads envelope.product_config_hash and owner.namespace from the actual typed record, rather than nonexistent top-level fields

Original selection generation must equal the stopped idle checkpoint generation, the nested product configuration commitment must match idle_config_hash, namespace must be LOCAL_RESEARCH and workflow_authorized must be exactly false

All three captured/restored/reback selections must equal the original OperationalSelection, including generation, configuration-envelope hash and exact canonical JSON; false workflow and namespace are also checked explicitly
The reader is live readonly for original/restored stores and immutable only for the verified sealed backup/rebackup canonical captures
backup_output validates the full revision and closed first/retryNN attempt, producing a different fresh path for retry01; existing output refusal preserves the failed first folder

Retainer and launch-guide select their backup stage through backup_output. The recorder separately validates the same closed attempt grammar and argument count and selects the explicit backup label; defaults point to first and fail closed when that checkpoint is failed
Actual qualification receipt equality, software readback, restored admission denial, RESTORED_INHIBITED, unchanged original history and source/package cleanup gates remain in place
The source tests obtain the real typed selection through the readonly canonical port. Negative record mutations are in-memory dataclass copies, not writes of financial or terminal state
